angle_selection.chosen_angle: The senior developer's role has shifted from writer to orchestrator — AI coding agents are no longer autocomplete tools but autonomous multi-agent workflows, and the real bottleneck is governance, not generation
angle_selection.rationale: Highest-scoring angle on search intent (informational + commercial for senior devs evaluating tooling), novelty (2026 multi-agent shift), and taxonomy alignment (senior-dev focus differentiates from generic AI coding content). Contradictions (productivity vs. editing overhead) and blindspots (governance gap, BYOAI) make this angle defensible and non-echo-chamber.

criteria.contrarian_risk: low — angle acknowledges downsides, not hype

labeled_truths.claim: 90% of devs use AI coding agents weekly; 68% daily
Claude Code leads at 39% adoption, 2x Copilot
Cursor: $2B ARR, $9.9B valuation, 1% to 22% adoption since Jan 2025
Top decile >30% productivity gains; ~50% of users >20%
AI PRs wait 4.6x longer in review; coding speed gains neutralized
15-18% more security vulns; secret-leak rate doubles (3.2% vs 1.5%)
Seniors 2x more likely to use AI than juniors
30% of seniors say editing AI output offsets most time savings
Claude Code Agent Teams: multi-agent parallel, experimental Feb 2026
Cursor 2.0: 8 parallel agents, Background Agent, Composer 2 (73.7% SWE-bench)
Role shift from writer to editor/orchestrator
66% frustration: AI 'almost right, not quite'; 45% debugging takes longer
83% orgs plan agentic AI; only 29% prepared to secure it; 35% BYOAI
Devin: $500 to $20/mo; Windsurf self-hosted; Copilot Agent Mode GA

contradictions.resolution: Gains are real but governance-dependent; seniors critical of output quality
Juniors overestimate gains; seniors more selective; adoption != outcome
Adoption flatlined; governance is the differentiator

blindspot_scan.echo_chamber_risk: medium — angle could default to hype without governance focus
blindspot_scan.injected_contrarian: Testing/QA remains <5% despite being #1 opportunity — the market is ignoring the bottleneck
blindspot_scan.narrative_first_risks: Claims C4 and C8 present opposing productivity narratives; the brief must present both without collapsing into contradiction
